title: Juicy Welsh Pistachio Yorkshire Pudding
description: A twist on the classic British dish, this recipe features the nutty flavor of unsalted pistachios and a crispy, golden-brown exterior.

ingredients.name: 1 cup chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley, thyme, and rosemary)

instructions: Whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add the pistachio meal and whisk until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottoms are golden brown.
Flip the Yorkshire puddings and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the Yorkshire puddings to a baking sheet and top each with a spoonful of shredded chicken, mashed sweet potatoes, chopped herbs, and grated cheese.
Drizzle with additional melted butter and serve hot.
